note: Display-only event follow-ups (src/macro/eventFollowup.ts). Each entry: an event (earnings), a mentor thesis with two baskets (expected down / expected up), and a time window. Phases (ET): pre (from showFrom until the event time) → after (event time until 04:00 next trading day; results + after-hours moves) → verdict (next trading day 04:00 until expires; premarket basket comparison). After `expires` nothing is shown. Inputs, all read-only and written by the routine: data/in/earnings-by-symbol.json (Robinhood get_earnings_results), data/in/quotes.json (Robinhood quotes: last = regular close, lastExt = extended-hours price), optional data/in/event-results.json for revenue / capex / FCF. No trades, no alerts, never feeds NO_TRADE, sizing, 48h/72h or 能不能睡.
